subject: Hero
text: The player's quest is to find and defeat the Dragonlord.

evidence.quote:
Your quest is to find and defeat the Dragonlord.  The time has come.  This
is the start of your adventure.

subject: Tantegel Castle
text: The Ball of Light was stolen from Tantegel Castle by the Dragonlord.

evidence.quote:
In the time of King Lorik XVI, the Ball of Light were stolen
from Tantegel Castle by the evil Dragonlord, and once again the Kingdom of
Alefgard was plunged into darkness.

subject: Charlock
text: Charlock is the dark castle belonging to the Dragonlord.

evidence.quote:
Many brave warriors tried to recover the Ball of Light, but none of them
returned from Charlock, the Dragonlord's dark castle.

subject: D-Pad
text: The D-Pad allows the character to move in any direction and scrolls menus.

evidence.quote:
*D-Pad* - The D-Pad (or Directional Pad) allows you to make your
character move in any direction that you want it to. It also allows you
to scroll the various menus in the game.

subject: Start button
text: The Start button pauses the game and selects items from menus.

evidence.quote:
*Start* - The Start button is used to pause the game and select some
things from menus, especially that of the beginning, before starting the
actual game itself.

subject: A button
text: The A button brings up menus, selects commands, and carries out instructions.

evidence.quote:
*A* - The A button is truly the primary button in the game. Through this
button, commands are selected and instructions are carried out. The
basic all around button. Brings up menus, used to select commands and
options on the menu.

subject: B button
text: The B button serves as a cancel button that closes the menu.

evidence.quote:
*B* - The "cancel" button. If you bring up the menu and you don't want
it up, you simply hit the B button to make it go away.

subject: Select button
text: The Select button has no function in the game.

evidence.quote: *Select* - The Select button has no function in this game.

subject: Battery save
text: The game allows players to save on one of three Adventure Log slots.

evidence.quote:
Select one of the three (there'll be
three, two, one, or even none, depending on how many saves are present
on the cartridge). "Adventure Log 1" (or 2 or 3) select.
